thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: autoscaler-oscillation detected in prod (us-east-1). metric: gpu_pool_utilization. spikes -> rapid scale ups/downs causing request failures. paging ryan-oncall and team. incident id: INC-20260315-8423 :rotating_light:
ryan-oncall: got it. i'm oncall. looking at autoscaler metrics now. can someone post recent spike graphs?
erin-sre: pulling logs for the last 30m. seeing repeated scale events: scale_up -> scale_down loop. kube events show NodeJoin/NodeTerminate churn.
mike-rtc: seeing a correlated burst of short-lived batch jobs from a customer integration (internal-job-runner). sending link to logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/trace/abcd1234
kate-csm: FYI, CSM told me a few enterprise customers reported 502/503s around 09:42-09:58. one raised a support ticket (SUP-5492).
dmitri-eng: could be autoscaler cooldown too short + pod readiness flapping. what's current autoscaler config?
erin-sre: current config snippet: ```yaml
minReplicas: 2
maxReplicas: 50
scaleUpPolicy: immediate
scaleDownCooldown: 30s
scaleUpCooldown: 10s
```
that scaleDownCooldown is probably too aggressive for GPU nodes.
ryan-oncall: immediate mitigation attempt: disabling aggressive scaleDown for the pool and forcing stable size to 12 while we investigate. running: `redwood-cli pool set --name gpu-us-east-1 --target 12`
ops-bot: ACTION: pool gpu-us-east-1 target set to 12 by ryan-oncall. previous target 6.
sarah-qa: after scaling target to 12, error rate dropped to baseline ~1.2% within 3 minutes. looks like mitigation worked. :thumbsup:
kate-csm: passing update to affected customers, telling them we mitigated and investigating root cause.
jasmin-ops: planning post-incident review. prefer a short postmortem meeting today. who can join? propose 16:00 UTC.
dmitri-eng: I can join. want to review autoscaler tuning, job throttling, and add hard limits on short batch bursts.
erin-sre: will prepare timeline + extracted logs.
ryan-oncall: assign follow-ups here. immediate action items in-thread: 1) revert scaleDownCooldown to safer value and add min cooldown 5m for GPU pools (owner: erin-sre) 2) add request throttling to internal-job-runner to smooth bursts (owner: dmitri-eng) 3) create alert that detects >3 scale events in 10m for same pool (owner: mike-rtc) 4) customer comms recap (owner: kate-csm) 5) add canary for autoscaler config changes (owner: jasmin-ops)
erin-sre: creating ticket INFRA-2741 with details and immediate config change notes. linking runbook: https://confluence.redwood/infrastructure/autoscaler-runbook
mike-rtc: I will add the "oscillation" alert rule and a dashboard panel showing scale events per minute.
ops-bot: TASK CREATED: INFRA-2741 (autoscaler cooldown and remediation) assigned to erin-sre.
jasmin-ops: scheduled postmortem meeting 2026-03-15 16:00 UTC. invite sent to participants and stakeholders. meeting link: https://meet.internal/redwood/pm-INC-20260315-8423
dmitri-eng: quick note — internal-job-runner had a recent deployment that changed retry policy; rolling back might reduce the burst. I'll coordinate with platform team.
kate-csm: customer updates sent. two customers requested SLA credit evaluation; capturing in SUP-5492.
erin-sre: after mitigation, adding a short-term guard in autoscaler logic: disallow scaleDown if last scaleUp < 300s. pushing patch to staging and will roll to prod after smoke. snippet: ```go
if now.Sub(lastScaleUp) < 5*time.Minute {
  skipScaleDown()
}
```
ryan-oncall: nice. once patch is live, let's monitor for 24h. set a follow-up check in status board.
sarah-qa: will run synthetic traffic tests to ensure we don't regress (target windows: 10m bursts and steady).
jasmin-ops: postmortem owners: infra -> erin-sre (write prose + timeline), eng -> dmitri-eng (root cause analysis + mitigation), devex -> mike-rtc (alerts + dashboards), support -> kate-csm (customer comms). deadline for draft: 2026-03-18 EOD.
erin-sre: draft created at https://confluence.redwood/postmortems/INC-20260315-8423-draft. linking logs and timeline.
dmitri-eng: created remediation epic: EPIC-1210 (autoscaler hardening). will break into tasks and add estimated ETA.
ops-bot: REMINDER: postmortem draft due 2026-03-18.
ryan-oncall: final note — we should add autoscaler simulation tests in CI to catch oscillation patterns before prod. filing infra task.
jasmine-ops: (typo) jasmin-ops: moving thread to follow-up and closing active paging; will reopen if new problems. :white_check_mark: 
incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-20260315-8423 status: mitigated — impact contained. severity: Sev2. closing page.
jasmin-ops: postmortem meeting notes will be appended to the confluence draft and action items tracked in EPIC-1210. thanks everyone for quick response.
ryan-oncall: handing off to erin-sre for follow-ups. I'm out of rotation.
erin-sre: ack. taking ownership of follow-ups. will post updates in INFRA-2741 as tasks progress.
